format: JavaScript (Node.js module for SvelteKit server routes)
description: Server-side route handler for a task board, handling data fetching, creation, updating, deletion, and movement of tasks and columns via API requests, specific to a project management or kanban board application.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches board details with columns and tasks from API based on URL parameters, handles errors, and returns structured data for the frontend.

methods.name: actions.createColumn
methods.description: Handles creation of a new column in the board via API POST request.

methods.name: actions.createTask
methods.description: Creates a new task within a specified column.

methods.name: actions.updateTask
methods.description: Updates details of an existing task, including moving it between columns.

methods.name: actions.deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task based on task ID.

methods.name: actions.moveTask
methods.description: Moves a task to a different column, updating its order.
